Review the stable cases below against the

### Traits

- “At a new inn, camp, or hall, I find the cook, porter, or cleaner everyone else talks past.”
- “In new company, I wait for two other people to reveal a secret before I offer one of mine.”

### Ideal

- “When keeping the peace requires silence about a wrong, I name it in front of the people asked to endure it.”

### Bond

- “The riverside shrine sheltered me during a winter storm; I send lamp oil whenever its keeper writes.”

### Flaw

- “When someone breaks a promise to me, I keep demanding proof long after they have made amends.”

### Story

1. “A rival and I pursued the same prize until an accident put it beyond either of us alone. I offered a temporary partnership, and sharing the result saved our work while making the next contest far more personal.”
2. “I kept escorting a wounded courier after the safe road closed. We arrived owing three favors, and the courier refuses to tell me what was in the message.”
3. “I am mapping a chain of guarded shelters where travelers can reach the next locked door before nightfall.”

### Traits

- “During an argument, I sharpen a blade or sort coins until I know which question to ask.”
- “I notice paths and exits before settling into an unfamiliar place.”

### Ideal

- “When the work is praised, I name the hands that did it before I accept my share.”

### Bond

- “I left a clockmaker’s commission unfinished after the foreman mocked my hands, and I still carry its missing gear.”

### Flaw

- “I assume the crew can manage without me and return only after the scaffold collapses.”

### Story

1. “I finished a clockwork survey after the other apprentices walked out. It works, but only they know why it gains a minute every midnight.”
2. “When a mason asked me to claim her bridge design, I named her before the council. My former sponsor now funds her next commission.”
3. “I intend to restore the dry well, broken handcart, and empty night watch in the poorest ward before winter.”

### Traits

- “Whenever I stop to rest, I point my boots toward the exit and sleep with the map under my left hand.”
- “I repeat a speaker’s rhythm when I want the room to remember their exact words.”

### Ideal

- “When a custom locks a servant in place, I show them where the household keeps its spare key.”

### Bond

- “The quartermaster who altered my pay ledger still has the original page, and I need it before the next audit.”

### Flaw

- “I rush to intervene before asking the people involved what help they actually want.”

### Story

1. “I led the kiln firing and ignored the clay mixer’s warning. Every vessel cracked, and the mixer kept one shard bearing my maker’s mark.”
2. “When the reeve locked a debtor in the grain shed, I pried open the back wall. The debtor escaped by another route and left my crowbar where the reeve could find it.”
3. “I am opening two escape routes from the debtors’ quarter and leaving every captive a contract copy and a hidden purse.”
